wizard.title: Create virtual device
wizard.subtitle: Build a device from another device's channels

category.heading: Choose a category
category.description: Pick the kind of device you are creating. It determines which channels and properties the next step will ask you to map.
category.blockedReason: needs a controller — planned for a later release

mapping.heading: Wire up the properties
mapping.description: Every property below comes from a real device. Fill at least the required ones — the rest are optional and can stay empty.
mapping.noRequired: This category has no required properties — map at least one to continue

shortcut.description: Take a whole channel: pick a channel on a real device and fill every property here that it can cover.
shortcut.applied: Filled {filled} of {total} properties from the selected channel.
shortcut.nothingApplied: The selected channel has no property this channel can use.

errors.checkFailed: This source could not be verified. Pick another one or try again.
errors.incompatible: This source cannot fill this property.

details.heading: Name and place the device
details.description: Give the device a name, and optionally assign it to a room and zones. A name is suggested from the category and room — you can change it.

review.heading: Review and create
review.description: Check the summary below, then create the device. Every property listed is borrowed from a real device's channel.
review.noMappings: Nothing is mapped yet — go back and map at least one property.

hideSource.label: Hide {device} — every property above comes from this device
hideSource.hint: Hides the source device from lists and pickers. It stays fully intact and can be unhidden again from the device list at any time.

errors.createFailed: The device could not be created. Please try again.
errors.hideFailed: The source device could not be hidden.
errors.hideFailedFlash: {device} was not hidden: the request failed. You can hide it later from the device list.
errors.zonesFailed: {count} zone(s) could not be assigned. You can add them later from the device list.

sources.heading: Source devices
sources.description: The physical devices this device's properties are borrowed from.
sources.empty: This device does not borrow from any other device.
sources.loadFailed: Source devices could not be loaded.

warning.title: {channel} · {property}: source lost
warning.description: The source property was deleted. This device stays offline until it is remapped.

remap.title: Remap {property}
remap.description: Choose a new source for this property. Only a compatible source can be confirmed.
remap.success: {property} now draws from a new source

errors.updateFailed: The property could not be remapped. Please try again.
